author: Riilo
body:
Minecraft Username: Riilo

Discord ID: Rilo#5735

In 1 or 2 sentences, tell me who you are: I'm Rilo. I have been on Avicus for 3 and a half years. I am a very active player on this server.

What is your Youtube channel? https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCZiLSyR0TYZk9PaO4GC1JSQ (All my YT vids are private/unlisted right now)

What software do you use when recording videos? Do you have experience editing videos? For about a month or two now I have been using/learning Sony Vegas Pro. I have a lot of experience and know quite a bit about Sony Vegas.

Have you ever advertised using YouTube? I have never advertised using Youtube unless making one server trailer a while ago counts.

Have you ever marketed something using Youtube before? No I have not

What changes would you like to see made on the Youtube team? I would like to see weekly videos on the Avicus channel showing new features, tutorials or maybe tournament/scrim gameplay. It would be nice to see the channel being used quite frequently, as it could attract new players to the server.

How active are you/how is your work ethic? I am very active with my work ethic, especially in the next 3 weeks or so as I am on holidays.
